title: Attributing Structured-Output Gains in Function Calling: Interface Alignment versus Procedural Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2607.02595v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Structured-output benchmarks reward both task decisions and interface compliance, so prompt-induced function-calling gains require attribution before they can be interpreted as transferable skill. We introduce a four-layer gain-attribution protocol for prompt-prepended skill injection, combining canonicalized rescoring, format-only controls, repaired/balanced induction, and portability checks. Applied to the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) and scoped with API-Bank, MATH-500, and MultiHop-RAG, the protocol shows that several apparent gains are better attributed to interface alignment than to procedural transfer: format-only prompts match or exceed full skills in key BFCL cells, repaired/balanced induction removes the largest sub-frontier gains, and API-Bank target-native gains are matched within 0.5 percentage points (pp) by length-matched generic procedural prompts. translated_title: 结构化输出在函数调用中的增益归因：接口对齐与程序性迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.02595v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：结构化输出基准同时奖励任务决策和接口合规性，因此提示引发的函数调用增益在可解释为可迁移技能之前需要进行归因。我们引入了一种四层增益归因协议，用于提示前置技能注入，结合了规范化重新评分、仅格式对照、修复/平衡归纳和可移植性检查。应用于伯克利函数调用排行榜（BFCL），并以API-Bank、MATH-500和MultiHop-RAG为范围，该协议表明若干表面增益更应归因于接口对齐而非程序性迁移：仅格式提示在BFCL关键单元中匹配或超过完整技能，修复/平衡归纳消除了最大的子前沿增益，且API-Bank目标原生增益与长度匹配的通用程序性提示在0.5个百分点（pp）内匹配。这些发现将格式合规视为一种有用的工程实践。
tldr: 本文通过四层增益归因协议揭示，函数调用中的结构化输出增益主要来自接口对齐而非程序性迁移，仅格式提示即可匹配或超越完整技能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a four-layer gain-attribution protocol revealing that structured-output gains in function calling primarily stem from interface alignment rather than procedural transfer, where format-only prompts match or exceed full skills.
